gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-supreme: Casual and personal, Coming Soon draws crossbars as fat as its stems. Supreme sits below as a crisp plain sans, a heavy-looking strip of text with its letters held open.
gen-gf-coming-soon-general-sans: Casual, personal Coming Soon is handwritten, with a round o and lowercase rising close to the capitals. General Sans keeps a steady pen pressure, so long text moves smoothly.
gen-gf-coming-soon-manrope: Casual and personal, Coming Soon brings handwritten charm, with a round o and lowercase that rises close to the capitals. Manrope does the other job, with bright open curves and caps barely taller than its lowercase.
gen-gf-coming-soon-satoshi: Casual and personal, Coming Soon is best at handwritten charm, its o a round ring. Satoshi handles the steady work, with a soaring x-height and an e that never squeezes shut.
gen-gf-coming-soon-switzer: Switzer is a sans-serif of tubular, wire-like letters, its c tips never creeping toward touching. Switzer gives the loose, handwritten Coming Soon a firm Swiss counterpart on the page.
gen-gf-coming-soon-work-sans: Work Sans is a modern sans-serif with a high mean line and c tips that never creep toward touching. Against casual Coming Soon, that tidy structure is the real draw.
gen-gf-crafty-girls-fs-bespoke-sans: Personal and relaxed, Crafty Girls writes with unpinched, unmodulated curves, while Bespoke Sans stays sharp and refined. Generous gaps between curve ends and stems keep longer text easy going.
gen-gf-crafty-girls-fs-literata: Crafty Girls is relaxed and handwritten, its skeleton monoweight throughout. Literata, a serif with sturdy thin lines and a mild felt-marker swell, adds a bookish weight that lifts the pair.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-archivo: Joins that never thin out where strokes meet give Delius Unicase its relaxed look, and Archivo opens its curves outward. That editorial, commanding x-height is what steadies the pair.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-asap: Delius Unicase is relaxed and inviting, with neon-tube strokes that never taper. Asap handles the readable work, its c forms open arcs and its body height nearly matching the capitals.
